title: AION 2 Macro Guide: Keybind and Skill Priority
description: Set up AION 2’s built-in skill macro, bind the activation key, arrange skill priorities and troubleshoot missing attacks or delay.
summary: Bind an activation key, start with a small hotbar stack and watch each attack. Keep healing, interrupts and movement reachable, then test the sequence while changing targets and reacting to mechanics.
quickAnswer: Bind the ability macro under Key Settings → General → Gameplay, open its editor and select a hotbar skill stack. Holding the key repeats the stack. Start with a short damage sequence and keep healing, movement and interrupts separate.
